checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Two fitted weighted ankle cuffs stay on the lower legs throughout the lift. Both feet clear the floor. Straight legs raise together to hip height or remain horizontal for the L hold; fixed hands and trunk, no swing.
checks.movement: Straight-leg hanging raise with two weighted ankle cuffs; 3.5 seconds up to hip height, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds down. Fixed trunk and overhead grip without swinging. Cuffs stay secured on the lower shins.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
